title: After Baume Moisture Barrier Recovery Cream

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, antioxidants, parabenFree, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Hydrating✓ Best for Dry Skin✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A powerful, fragrance-free, moisture barrier recovery cream that provides up to 24 hours of hydration for dry and sensitized skin.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, and Combination

Skincare Concerns: Dryness and Dullness

Formulation: Rich Cream

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Cupuaçu Butter: Helps skin retain moisture.
- Babassu Oil: Rich in vitamin E, antioxidants, fatty acids, and melts and absorbs into skin.
- Postbiotic Ferment: Helps supports in skin's microbiome.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This cream has a thick occlusive formula that includes glycerin to attract moisture, cupuaçu butte
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use only after thoroughly cleansing skin.
-Warm a pea-size amount of cream between fingers to melt the formula.
-Gently massage cream into skin as the last step in your skincare routine.
-Start with a small amount of product and increase as needed depending on dryness.
-Use cream after exposure to harsh weather or environments (cold, sun, pollution).
-Apply cream onto very dry areas such as nose crevices, cuticles, elbows, knees, ankles, or any other dry areas of skin.
-Use in the evening as an overnight moisture cream which cocoons skin.
-Use cream after using skincare products containing retinoids, chemical exfoliators, and acne treatments.
Ingredients+
-Cupuaçu Butter: Helps skin retain moisture.
-Babassu Oil: Rich in vitamin E, antioxidants, fatty acids, and melts and absorbs into skin.
-Postbiotic Ferment: Helps supports in skin's microbiome.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Phytosteryl/Isostearyl/Cetyl/Stearyl/Behenyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Orbignya Oleifera Seed Oil, Glycerin, Phytosteryl/Behenyl/Octyldodecyl Lauroyl Glutamate, Theobroma Grandiflorum Seed Butter, Cetearyl Olivate, Glyceryl Stearate, Cetearyl Alcohol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Lactobacillus Ferment Lysate Filtrate, Sorbitan Olivate, Ethyl Linoleate, Inulin Lauryl Carbamate, Chlorella Vulgaris Extract, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Tocopherol, Arginine, Sclerotium Gum, Propanediol, Sorbitan Isostearate, Lactic Acid, Dimethicone, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Hydroxyacetophenone.
